question: Appendicitis, EXCEPT
question_ar: جميع الجمل المتعلقة بالتهاب الزائدة الدودية صحيحة باستثناء؟

options.text: Mcburney point corresponds to the location of the base of appendix
Psoas sign is elicited by extension of the right hip
Laparoscopy is one of the diagnostic methods
Rovsing sign is elicited by pressing in the left iliac fossa causing pain in the right iliac fossa
Alvardo score is not routinely calculated for the diagnosis of appendicitis

correct_text: Alvardo score is not routinely calculated for the diagnosis of appendicitis
